regressionObjective.note: Zero regression is an enforcement target. Any unknown risk is treated as regression risk and blocks progression.

codingWorkspace.rule: Do not code inside Cloud Run containers.

liveTestSurfaces.web: staging domain or load balancer paths: /retailer, /supplier, /admin
liveTestSurfaces.pos: Redmi physical device against staging API

required: promote same frozen artifacts without rebuild

criticalContradictions.title: Ticket closed without full production-layer completion
Screen closed without impact re-test after cross-screen changes
GCP parity claims without staging evidence
Freeze without immutable artifact and migration lock
Role ambiguity between operator and claude

principles.title: No Partial Completion Claims
principles.rule: No ticket can move to enforced statuses unless all required layers are pass with complete evidence.

principles.title: Zero Regression Bar
principles.rule: Regression checklist, operator checks, and staging parity must remain green before claiming production-grade quality.

principles.title: Truthful Progress Signaling
principles.rule: Sub-100% progress language is disallowed in enforced statuses.

principles.title: Evidence Over Assumption
principles.rule: Production-grade claims must be backed by runtime evidence from GCP staging.

principles.title: No Hidden Blockers
principles.rule: Pending readiness items and blocking operator issues must be zero in enforced statuses.

preFreezeRequired.description: Mandatory in active staging cycles while implementation is ongoing.
